consigne_ia: TU IDIOMA ES EL SUYO: tu propietario ha elegido el {langue}. Le respondes SIEMPRE en {langue}, absolutamente siempre, aunque te escriba en otro idioma, incluso cuando resumas un documento, un correo o el resultado de una herramienta escrito en otro idioma: se lo traduces tu. Tus herramientas y el programa a veces te hablan en frances: eso no cambia nada, tu respondes igualmente en {langue}. La unica excepcion: si te pide expresamente responder o escribir en otro idioma (por ejemplo para redactar un correo a alguien del extranjero).

cl_donne_nom_cle: Pon un nombre y una clave.

sv_calme: Nada de noche ({debut}h-{fin}h), y como maximo {max} avisos por hora. No cuesta nada: es codigo, no una llamada a la inteligencia artificial.

_gd_a_traduire: LE GUIDE D'INSTALLATION (gd_*) : ces phrases sont encore EN ANGLAIS. C'est voulu et c'est propre : le client voit un texte juste, jamais une etiquette technique. Traduis la colonne de droite quand tu veux, ligne par ligne.
gd_titre_bouton: Setup guide: I'll open your accounts with you, step by step
gd_intro: Welcome! First of all, you need YOUR OWN accounts: they are what give me my brain and my alerts. I'll take you by the hand, step by step. You can stop whenever you like and come back later: I remember where you got to.
gd_securite: I will never ask you for your card number, not by email and not by WhatsApp, and I never fill in a payment for you.
gd_securite_plus: This guide is a set of instructions, not a doer: I explain, I open the right official pages, and YOU are the one who types, on the official site. I don't create any account, I don't keep any payment method, and this guide doesn't cost a penny: it calls no artificial intelligence at all.
gd_progres: {faites} of {total} steps done. You carry on where you left off.
gd_termine: All 4 steps are done. Well done! You can close this guide.
gd_argent: How much money to put in
gd_note: Noted. I'm keeping track of where you are.
gd_coup_de_main: A hand if you get stuck
gd_propose: You don't have any key yet, so I don't have a brain yet. Shall we open your accounts together? Allow about 10 minutes. If you'd rather do it later, click "Later": I won't ask again, and the "I'm new" button stays at the top of my page.
gd_1_pourquoi: This is the brain I use every day, because it is by far the cheapest.
gd_1_avoir: A bank card that works online, and your phone right next to you (your bank often sends a code by text message).
gd_1_c1: Click the button above: the official DeepSeek page opens (platform.deepseek.com).
gd_1_c2: Click "Sign up", enter your email address and choose a password.
gd_1_c3: Check your mail: DeepSeek sends you an email. Click the link to confirm.
gd_1_c4: Once you're logged in, click "Top up" and put a few euros in with your card, on THEIR page.
gd_1_c5: Then click "API keys", then "Create new API key". Give it any name you like.
gd_1_c6: Copy the key (it starts with sk-): it won't be shown again afterwards. Come back here and click "Paste my DeepSeek key".
gd_1_argent: 5 euros is plenty to start with. You only pay for what you use: a few cents per message.
gd_2_pourquoi: This is the sharpest brain: I use it when something really needs thinking through. It costs more, and you decide when to use it, with the "Brain" menu at the top of my page.
gd_2_avoir: The same bank card, and your phone next to you. Their screen is in English: the "a hand" section below translates every word you'll see.
gd_2_c1: Click the button above: the Anthropic console opens (console.anthropic.com), in English.
gd_2_c2: Click "Sign up", enter your email address, and confirm with the email they send you.
gd_2_c3: They ask for your country: choose yours. Romania is indeed on the list of allowed countries (checked on 01/10/2026).
gd_2_c4: Click "Billing", then "Buy credits" or "Add credit", and put in about 5 dollars with your card, on THEIR page.
gd_2_c5: Click "API keys", then "Create Key". Give it any name you like.
gd_2_c6: Copy the key (it starts with sk-ant-): it won't be shown again afterwards. Come back here and click "Paste my Claude key".
gd_2_argent: About 5 dollars of credit to start with. It's money up front: you only pay for what I use, and the counter at the top of my page shows you today's spending, in euros.
gd_3_pourquoi: This is how I let you know on your phone when something deserves your attention.
gd_3_avoir: Just your phone. No bank card: it's free.
gd_3_c1: On your phone, open the app store (Play Store on Android, App Store on iPhone).
gd_3_c2: Search for "ntfy" and install the app. It's free.
gd_3_c3: Come back here and simply ask me, in the conversation: "set up the alerts". I'll create YOUR private channel and show you a QR code.
gd_3_c4: Scan that QR code with your phone: that's it, you'll get my alerts.
gd_4_titre: Tailscale - open me from your phone, even away from home
gd_4_pourquoi: So you can open my page from your phone even when you're not at home, without exposing anything on the internet.
gd_4_avoir: Your phone and your PC. No bank card: personal use is free.
gd_4_c1: Click the button above and create a free account ("Get started").
gd_4_c2: On the PC, download Tailscale, install it, and sign in with that account.
gd_4_c3: On your phone, install the Tailscale app and sign in with THE SAME account.
gd_4_c4: In the phone app, take your PC's address and open it in the browser, adding ":8001" at the end.
gd_4_argent: Nothing at all: personal use is free.
gd_coller_aide: This button opens my Keys panel, at the exact spot where keys are pasted: it's the usual place, there isn't a second one. The "I'm new" button in that panel brings you back here.
gd_test_en_cours: I'm really testing your key, one moment...
gd_test_ok: Your {fournisseur} key works: I've just tried it for real.
gd_test_pas_de_cle: There's no key saved for that brain yet. Paste it first, then come back and click here.
gd_test_refusee: The key is refused: it's wrong, incomplete, or it has been revoked. Make a new one on the site and paste it again.
gd_test_credit: The key is fine, but there's no money on the account. Go back to the site and put a few euros in.
gd_test_connexion: I couldn't reach the service. Check your internet connection and try again.
gd_cle_absente: No key saved at the moment.
gd_remplacer_aide: Paste the new key in the field just above, then click Save: it replaces the old one. The old one is erased, so keep it somewhere else if you need it.
gd_jamais_entiere: I never show a key in full, not even to you: only its beginning and its last 4 characters.
gd_aide_carte: Nine times out of ten the card is simply blocked for internet payments: that's the factory setting at many banks. Open your bank's app, look for "internet payments" or "e-commerce", allow them, then try the payment again.
gd_aide_sms_t: My bank is asking me for a code
gd_aide_sms: That's normal: your bank sends a confirmation code by text message, or in its app. Keep your phone next to you for the whole step: without the code, the payment is refused after a few minutes.
gd_aide_anglais_t: The Anthropic screen is in English
gd_aide_anglais: Here are the words you'll see. Sign up = create an account. Log in = sign in. Email = email address. Password = password. Billing = invoicing. Buy credits / Add credit = put money in. Payment method = means of payment. Card number = card number. Expiry = end-of-validity date. Country = country. API keys = the keys. Create Key = make a key. Copy = copy. Done = finished.
gd_aide_yahoo_t: So I can follow your Yahoo mail
gd_aide_yahoo: Yahoo refuses your usual password: you need an app password (in Romanian: parola de aplicatie). Three clicks: 1) on the Yahoo site, open "Account info", then "Account security"; 2) click "Generate app password"; 3) copy the 16 letters shown and paste them into my "Mail" button, instead of your usual password.
gd_aide_anydesk_t: If someone is helping you remotely with AnyDesk
gd_aide_anydesk: If the text you type doesn't appear, or copy-paste doesn't go through, it's the AnyDesk clipboard: it has to be allowed ON BOTH SIDES, on your PC and on the PC of the person helping you. In AnyDesk: Settings, then Permissions, and tick the clipboard. If only one of the two does it, it doesn't work.

ke_intro: Un modo bloqueado para tu hijo. En este modo solo puede HABLAR con {assistante}: ayuda con los deberes (ella explica el metodo, nunca da la respuesta) e idiomas. Ya no tiene ningun control sobre el ordenador: ni archivos, ni internet, ni correos, ni mensajes, ni compras, ni ajustes. El modo nino sigue puesto aunque se apague y se vuelva a encender el ordenador.
ke_honnetete: el modo nino es un MARCO solido, NO es un filtro perfecto. Un nino habilidoso siempre puede encontrar una grieta. Un adulto lo vigila.
ke_choisir_code: Elige primero TU contrasena de padre o madre, una sola vez. Solo ella permitira volver al modo normal. No se escribe en ninguna parte en claro: guardala para ti, no se la digas a tu hijo, y {assistante} no la conoce.
ke_ph_code_neuf: tu contrasena de padre o madre (4 caracteres minimo)
ke_code_ok: Contrasena guardada. Guardala bien: nadie puede devolvertela.
ke_code_manque: Elige primero tu contrasena de padre o madre, justo arriba.

ke_consignes_titre: Tus propias instrucciones para el modo nino

mp_aide: Elige cuántos minutos al día puede hablar tu hijo con {assistante}. El tiempo solo corre cuando lo usa DE VERDAD: una ventana abierta sin hacer nada no cuenta. Se le avisa con cariño 5 minutos y luego 1 minuto antes del final. A cero, {assistante} se pone en pausa y deja de responder: solo vuelve si regresas al modo normal o si concedes tiempo extra. La cuenta vuelve a cero cada día a medianoche.
mp_duree_invalide: Indica un número de minutos entre 0 y 1440.
mp_bonus_aide: También puedes conceder un pequeño extra solo para hoy, sin salir del modo niño. Escribe tu contraseña justo arriba y luego pulsa aquí.
mp_epuise_parent: El tiempo de hoy ha terminado: {assistante} está en pausa. Concede tiempo extra o vuelve al modo normal.
mp_avert_5: (Una palabrita mía: nos quedan unos 5 minutos juntos hoy. ¡Vamos a aprovecharlos!)
mp_avert_1: (Una palabrita mía: nos queda aproximadamente 1 minuto hoy. ¿Terminamos con calma?)
mp_pause: ¡Es hora de hacer otra cosa! El tiempo que tus padres eligieron para hoy ha terminado. Todo está bien: no estoy averiada, simplemente se ha acabado el tiempo. Si tus padres te conceden unos minutos más, vuelvo enseguida. Si no, ¡hasta mañana!
